title: Custody chain forwarding logic
description: When a custodian has a stored message and the destination becomes reachable (via RPL/Announce/Yggdrasil), forward by POSTing to the next custody-capable node or directly to the recipient. On 2.01 from next custodian, delete local copy. On 2.04 from final recipient, delete local copy. On failure, retain and retry until TTL expires. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1 custody chain. All three impls. Depends on: custody store (ldhl.3), custody resource handler (ldhl.5).
